Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4690. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
